versions.content: With development error detection IdsMDevErrorDetect en- abled, the IdsM module shall check the parameter securityEventId of the function IdsM_SetSecurityEvent against the configured security events, and shall report the development error IDSM_E_PARAM_INVALID when an unknown event ID is pro- vided by the service call. An unknown event is an event that has not been configured in IdsMEvent .
